ai.description: Video created by AI, with little manual editing or human intervention

children.aimusic: Multiple b-roll scenes with an AI voiceover that sings your product's story. video example
children.reviews: Showcases customer ratings, testimonials in UGC or reaction style
children.prompt: Different characters answering the same question prompt on screen about the product - Video Example
children.povwalktalk: Walk-and-talk POV style videos set in multiple locations - video example
children.painpoint: Introducing the product that focuses on the pain point and solutions. video example
children.beforeafter: Before-and-after journey that shows results from using the product. video example
children.cameraroll: Multiple b-roll scenes set to music, no voiceover, with a camera roll hook - video example
children.aesthetic: Aesthetic lifestyle b-rolls for product showcase & tryons. video example
children.lookbook: A single model showcases one outfit across different locations, creating a "one look, many vibes" fashion lookbook. video example
children.tedtalk: A keynote-style talking head paired with supporting b-roll clips about your product - video example
children.interview: street interview, podcast style interview (2 Person Podcast, Animal Interview), Conference Style Interview, Multi Conversations, TV shows
children.newsroom: "Breaking News" hook with street interviews to promote the product. video example
children.display: Focus on the sequential presentation of product details, without featuring any human faces
children.tryon: Content showcasing models presenting apparel or products through product displays, vlog-style, or lifestyle formats, with an emphasis on highlighting product details. Mirror Tryon, Unboxing Tryon,
children.overlay: Videos contains overlay/frame design to include feature callouts, a product cutout, and a branded CTA etc. examples: Split Screen Try-On , Multi-Outfit Styling Reel
children.splitscreen: A top-and-bottom, left-and-right split-screen showcasing the product in use and in detail. Look & Detail Split Screen
children.recommend: Showcasing friend recommendations to build trust and credibility. Friends Recommendation
children.closeup: A product close-up visuals with real-life use cases and condition-based callouts. Condition Callout
children.story: Story-driven content/experience of using the product.

game.description: User interacts with a game mechanic before reaching the CTA

children.rollingdice: users tap to stop the dice on and reveal a discount
children.colorgrid: User launches colored balls to match the correct target, progressing through a simple aim-and-match challenge
children.memorycard: User flips cards to find matching pairs
children.bowling: User swipes to bowl and knock down products
children.platformer: User taps to jump over obstacles in an endless runner while progressing toward the featured product
children.clearblock: places puzzle pieces to clear rows or columns
children.hiddenobject: User needs to find hidden objects
children.bet1: The user is offered to place bets to get a reward. Side by side bet
children.bet2: The user is offered bets to get a reward. Grid-style lineup selection
children.catalog: Catalogue-style MIP where users swipe to explore and play multiple content pieces, especially for drama apps
children.chatbot: Chat-style mips that mimics a messaging interface with typed or tap-to-select responses
children.walkthrough: Step-by-step MIP showcase of an app’s core features and functionality
children.reader: Text-based, reader-style MIP focused on narrative or informational content
children.beforeafter: User swipes to reveal a side-by-side product transformation
children.carnivalduck: User taps to shoot ducks, uncovering product benefits with each hit
children.conveyorbelt: Products move along a conveyor belt for the user to sort
children.findmatch: User flips tiles to match pairs, revealing the product as the reward
children.ninjaslash: User slashes through objects to uncover the featured product
children.recipeformula: Ingredient icons combine in a visual equation to reveal the product
children.slider: User drags a slider to compare a before-and-after product result
children.vendingmachine: User selects sort the products in a vending machine
children.plinko: User drops a chip down and watch it bounce into a reward slot
children.whacamole: User use a mallet to hit products back to their holes
children.spintocatch: The user needs to "catch" a moving object in the right position to get a reward
children.catch: The user needs to catch falling objects to get a reward
children.spaceshooter: User use a space/tool to shoot products for rewards
children.flappybird: Fast-paced tap-to-fly arcade game where players dodge obstacles to score items
children.bubbles: Tap or shoot to pop bubbles
children.sort: Sort identical products across different categories, or organize the same product by color into separate boxes, cabinets, vending machines, and more.
children.spinwheel: Spin the wheel to reveal a product, a special sale, or another surprise message
children.bingo: Bingo mechanics to reveal a product, a special sale, or another surprise or winning message
children.box: Select from multiple hidden boxes or options to reveal a surprise - similar to an unboxing experience, mystery box, popping a balloon, or opening a gift box
children.drag: Drag-and-drop items to reach a target
children.runner: User need to swipe left-right to collect items
children.word: Spell/Connect letters to make a word related to the products
children.ingredients: Pick and drag product ingredients to build the product itself

motion.description: Video created and edited by humans, incorporating animation, existing static assets, and video footage

children.static: static converted video, with/without animation and music, usually 15s long
children.mashup: longer-form video combining multiple statics and/or video clips with animation, transitions, text, logo, and music for a more comprehensive product showcase, usually 45s - 60s
children.edit: adding subtitles, disclaimers, or banners to existing video assets
children.receipt: Animated receipt layout that reveals discounts, free items and savings - video example

product.description: Static or lightly interactive presentation focused on communicating product value

children.infographic: Text-driven layout showcasing product features, benefits, or customer stats — no product imagery as hero
children.carousel: Animation scrolls through a sequence of product cards or content panels.
children.grid: Animation with panels, usually 3x3, 2x2 to show product
children.stream: Products align in rows or columns with a stream/falling sequential animation
children.rotate: Products align as a circle in a 360 rotating animation
children.text: Copy-focused card — no product images, typically headline + value prop + CTA, such as iphone notes, white board, email templates
children.card: Single product hero image with tagline/price; no extended detail, with or without light animation
children.landing: Scrollable mini-landing-page experience with multiple sections
children.reviews: Showcases customer ratings, testimonials, or UGC
children.beforeafter: Side-by-side or slider comparing before/after states
children.pop: Products remain fixed in position while rapidly switching colors or designs with a popping animation effect
children.video: Embedded video clip as the primary showcase element
children.billboard: Product is showcased as a large outdoor advertisement display
children.localize: localizations for mip, sip, gif, and video creatives
children.receipt: receipt layout that reveals discounts, free items and savings
children.stickynote: Key message is handwritten and delivered via an animated sticky note
children.notes: Text-heavy layout mimicking the iPhone Notes app
children.checkoutcart: Checkout cart layout that reveals discounts, free items, and savings
children.falling: Products align in columns with a falling sequential animation
children.whiteboard: Copy-focused card mimicking a whiteboard, with information and product images
children.float: Product hero image with tagline and price; no extended detail, with or without light animation

children.survey: Multi-question preference input that feeds a recommendation

ugc.description: Live-action videos featuring real people and products

children.reviews: Showcases customer ratings, testimonials in UGC or reaction style
children.interview: street interview, podcast style interview, TV shows
children.tryon: Content showcasing models presenting apparel or products through product displays, vlog-style, or lifestyle formats, with an emphasis on highlighting product details.
children.story: Story-driven content highlighting a detailed transformational journey before and after using the product.
children.edit: adding subtitles, disclaimers, or banners to existing video assets

concept3.aiassisted: Partially completed by human with AI assistance

subconcept.dd: dynamic device: content changes based on the user's device (e.g. showing ios android or device type: iphone, Google Pixel, Samsung, Xiaomi)
subconcept.dt: dynamic time: content changes based on the current date/time (e.g. displaying "TODAY" and the actual date XX/XX on user's device)
subconcept.dh: dynamic holiday: messaging switches during specific holiday periods and stays evergreen the rest of the time (e.g. a Labor Day or Black Friday sale message that only appears during the sale window)
subconcept.dtd: dynamic time & device: combines dt and dd
subconcept.none: no dynamic element - use this for all regular creatives (most common value)

theme.unique: for brand's unique holiday/sale season that's not included in the above list
